A marker/design label is not an entity registration or live adapter. Encounter ownership is dimension-local SavedData dynasty_dungeons_v1. Encounter key instance/dungeon retains READY->STARTING reservation with random attempt -> exact admitted living Mob identity/type/position/tag -> ACTIVE and at most64 participants -> matching dead actor/type/attempt -> DEFEATED. STARTING invalid/partial loads fail closed; recovery adopts one matching already loaded actor without chunk loads or spawning. No kill-credit requirement for a particular participant is used in this encounter completion chain.

Player eligibility for coffin is living survival/noncreative/nonspectator, same required dimension and both bounded arena box and ellipse. Full interact path additionally requires live server player, <=36 squared distance, valid authored coffin/controller and encounterOrigin. World first_kill reward key dungeon/first_kill/world intentionally omits instance and player; it is dimension-local, not automatically global across every dimension. First eligible participant who invokes claim after DEFEATED reserves generated bundle to their UUID. It is not automatically the final hitter, earliest entrant or getKillCredit actor. Personal key dungeon/first_kill/player/UUID is separate and also omits instance. Second participant can obtain personal but not transfer first claimant world escrow.

Claim prepares both absent world/personal loot bundles before reserving either, requires nonempty <=128 list entries and current binding dependencies. reserveReward only absent keys and setDirty; pending stacks are copied and empty ones filtered. Delivery mutates exact pending stack counts via inventory.add and broadcasts on count change; full inventory stays escrow, no world-item fallback. Partial physical insertion is progress even if inventory.add return ignored. Empty receipt key remains tombstone. Malformed owner null cannot receive; it remains no-reroll, not recovered or reassigned. This is source normal-return order, not crash atomicity.

Player Clone checks two distinct ServerPlayers with equal UUID, whitelists typed root fields and preserves valid merit budget timestamp+spent amount together; malformed/partial pair is diagnosed without new-budget guarantee. First-kill flags from root or PlayerPersisted OR true into target root while leaving nested aliased whole container untouched. It never reads/copies world dungeon store, pending escrow, boss-death world journal, FTB files, active combat/control state or calls reward delivery. Current retained old-world boundary already read these claim/store/escrow facts; this study adds full encounter ownership and quest consumer context, external new reference credit0.

Full inventory has player.drop fallback, unlike dungeon escrow. Calling this API to migrate or to simulate a quest completion risks new rewards and sound; no such call performed.

Full BossDeathState keeps separate dimension-local boss UUID journal, snapshots Killer UUID and captured loot/XP, delays source sequence, tracks LootPlaced/XPAwarded/RewardGranted/FirstKillGranted/WorldApplied/Cleaned. Offline Killer delays only first-kill award until matching login even if cleaned; join rejects cleaned corpse, alive revival clears managed journal. RetryAt is removed on load.
